create_source_record: create a Source ORM record from a filename and md5sum using get_or_create with a SQLAlchemy session
create_dependency_record: create a Dependency ORM record by parsing a name==version string via get_or_create with a session
create_artifact_from_file: create an Artifact ORM instance from a binary file using the create class method with name and filename
create_experiment_record: create an Experiment ORM record with sources and dependencies using get_or_create with experiment info dict
query_run_to_json: query a Run ORM record and serialize it to JSON using the to_json method with nested relationships
